thread:
maria: quick idea — prototype for compact 'credit envelopes' to reduce event size on the billing pipeline. send a small delta + provenance pointer instead of the full token blob.
kevin: ok can you sketch the wire shape?
maria: simple example:```json
{
  "tenant": "t-123",
  "delta": 42,
  "prov_ptr": "pf:sha256:abc123",
  "ts": 1719102222
}
```
sam: so full provenance lives somewhere else (audit store), and billing consumes the compact envelope via pointer lookup? what's the lookup latency budget?
maria: exactly. idea is billing fastpath doesn't block on full provenance. we emit an async audit record that contains the expanded token lineage. billing uses the pointer for reconciles.
julie: main worry: dedupe & replay protection. if billing sees only pointers, how do we guard double-charge on retries? we need a monotonic per-tenant sequence or idempotency key in the envelope.
maria: good call — include idempotency keys. updated shape:```json
{
  "tenant": "t-123",
  "delta": 42,
  "prov_ptr": "pf:sha256:abc123",
  "idempotency_key": "i-2026-0001",
  "ts": 1719102222
}
```
kevin: rough numbers — proto shows ~60% event size reduction (from ~1.2KB down to ~480B). at 5M events/day that's ~3GB/day saved just on egress and kafka storage. latency win for billing ingest (p99) looks like -25ms in local tests.
sam: audit story: we keep a write-once audit stream that contains expanded tokens + the same idempotency_key. reconciliation job joins by idempotency_key when audits arrive late.
julie: what about tenant-level access to full provenance (security/compliance)? audits must be access-controlled and TTL'd. also KMS tagging for keys.
maria: agree — audit stream will be in encrypted bucket with tenant ACLs. short-term TTL 90d, long-term backup for legal holds.
ingest-bot: [ingest-bot] accepted 1 message for t-123 at 1719102225, partition 42 (trace: tr-7a8c)
maria: operational fallback: if prov_ptr missing or audit delivery fails, billing will apply a conservative fallback charge and mark for later reconcile. we should have a reconciler that can flip those to actual delta when audit arrives.
kevin: one more tradeoff: compact envelopes decouple billing SLO from audit SLO — good for latency but increases eventual consistency. we need SLA docs for devs on expected reconciliation window (proposal: 48h).
julie: backfill/backwards compatibility — for historical replays we may need to expand compact envelopes. suggestion: keep a small provenance cache (sidecar) keyed by prov_ptr for N hours to avoid expensive cold reads during canary.
maria: plan: canary on 1% tenants for 48h, enable compact envelopes with idempotency keys + audit stream. add reconciler job and sidecar cache. i'll open a follow-up RFC and ops runbook.
kevin: thumbs up. can we add metrics: compact_ratio, audit_lag_seconds, reconciler_failures?
sam: and a dashboard for outstanding conservative_falls.
maria: noted — will add to RFC. thanks all :thumbsup:
